name: Maria Beverly Caron
quote: To the entire NDN School team, thank you for loving, supporting, and believing in my son. We will always cherish the care, guidance, and opportunities that NDN School has provided.
fullQuote:
I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the entire NDN School team for the incredible support and care you have given my son, Samuel.

When Samuel joined this prestigious school two years ago, it marked the beginning of a remarkable journey of growth and development. Throughout his challenges, the teachers continuously encouraged and supported him, helping him become more confident and bringing out the very best in him.

I would like to extend my heartfelt thanks to Ms. Mahesh and Ms. Gayani for their dedication and guidance. Your efforts have played an important role in Samuel's progress and success.

I would also like to express my deepest appreciation and special thanks to Ms. Pradeepa, who has nurtured my son with exceptional care and commitment. Ms. Pradeepa is truly an extraordinary teacher. She did not simply treat Samuel as her student; she embraced him with the kindness, patience, and affection of a trusted friend and caring teacher.

She has always been eager to support Samuel in every aspect of his development. Despite the challenges he faced in school, Ms. Pradeepa made his learning journey easier and more enjoyable. Since Ms. Pradeepa became Samuel's shadow teacher, I have witnessed tremendous improvements in him. He became more talkative, started interacting and playing with his peers, shared stories with his classmates, participated more actively in class, and gained the confidence to recite in front of others.

One of the most memorable milestones was seeing Samuel perform during his graduation. Dancing in front of a large audience was a significant challenge for him, yet he overcame his fears and did it successfully. As a parent, there is no greater joy than watching your child grow, achieve milestones, and gain confidence.

Thank you, Ms. Pradeepa. You are truly a gem in Samuel's life, and your dedication has made a lasting difference. Words alone are not enough to express our gratitude for everything you have done.

To the entire NDN School team, thank you for loving, supporting, and believing in my son. We will always cherish the care, guidance, and opportunities that NDN School has provided. Your kindness and dedication have left a lasting impact on Samuel and our family.

name: Jayalakshmi Menon
quote: He was welcomed with warmth, formed wonderful friendships, and found joy in his everyday experiences. Over time, he has grown both emotionally and academically, thriving in the nurturing and supportive environment you’ve created.
fullQuote:
Just as a mother cherishes her child’s first steps and milestones, Atharv’s first experience of schooling will always remain close to my heart.

In March 2023, Atharv began his journey with NDN, and it was truly a beautiful start. He was welcomed with warmth, formed wonderful friendships, and found joy in his everyday experiences. Over time, he has grown both emotionally and academically, thriving in the nurturing and supportive environment you’ve created.

As he now moves forward to a new chapter in life, I want to take this moment to express my heartfelt gratitude to the incredible teachers and staff who have laid the foundation of his early learning journey.

A special thank you to his first teacher, Ms. Saranga, whose gentle and loving presence helped him feel safe and cared for from the very beginning. And a sincere appreciation to Ms. Shubra, who became a guiding light and a second mother to him. Her care, encouragement, and constant support have played a key role in shaping Atharv into the child he is today. I’ve seen remarkable growth in his emotional development, and I’m especially grateful for her support not just at school, but also in guiding us with activities and suggestions at home.

I would also like to extend my thanks to Mr. Tulsi and Mr. Jahabeer for always ensuring his safe journey to school, and to the classroom assistants Ms. Meneka and Ms. Vanessa for their patience and support.

Thank you, Ms. Shefali and the entire NDN team, for fostering such a positive, joyful environment during these precious early years. These memories and learnings will be cherished forever.
